# BrontoUI review candidate

This archive pins `@ponchia/ui` 0.11.0 from public commit
`c2008fd998ca5c251d7720c68f6218b988b8db48` (Ponchia/bronto-ui PR 204).
It allows consumer CI before npm publication; integrity is locked in
`package-lock.json`. Replace the file dependency with the exact registry version
and remove this directory after publication, before releasing this consumer.
The archive includes the upstream MIT license.
